items.title: Geen penalty voor vastgehouden Van Hooijdonk: 'Ik vind het schandalig'
items.summary: Sydney van Hooijdonk snapte er na afloop nog steeds niets van dat PEC Zwolle geen strafschop kreeg voor het vasthouden van Calvin Twigt aan zijn adres. Bij een gelijke stand vergreep de Willem II-middenvelder zich opzichtig aan Van Hooijdonk, maar een strafschop kwam er niet. De spits van PEC bleef verbouwereerd achter. 'Ik vind het heel krom.'

items.title: Barry scores twice as Everton fight back to beat Coventry
items.summary: In-form Thierno Barry scores twice as Everton came from behind to beat Coventry as the Toffees move into fifth in the Premier League table.

items.title: Thierno Barry double fires Everton to comeback win against Coventry
items.summary: The wildly optimistic Evertonian – if such a being exists – could not have envisaged David Moyes’ side fifth in the Premier League with Thierno Barry just behind Erling Haaland in the goalscoring chart when their transfer window closed in calamitous fashion. Yet there they sit, team and striker defying all expectations, following a stirring comeback against luckless Coventry. Frank Lampard endured a torturous night against his old club as Coventry impressed but were refused two strong penalty claims. The Coventry manager felt his team were denied a third time by the video assistant referee for an apparent handball by Barry when edging Everton ahead. Replays were inconclusive. It was the dancing French forward’s second goal of the game and 10th in all competitions this season. He also delivered a fine assist for Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall as the in-form midfielder put his latest England disappointment behind him to seal victory in convincing style. Continue reading...

items.title: Italiaanse degradatiekraker eindigt in mineur voor Udinese van Ekkelenkamp
items.summary: Hekkensluiter Willem II nam het vrijdagavond op tegen PEC Zwolle. De ploeg van Jurgen Streppel hoopte op de eerste Eredivisie-zege van het seizoen, maar moest het doen met een gelijkspel. Ook werd er volop gevoetbald in de Keuken Kampioen Divisie en was er buitenlands voetbal. Lees de voetbalavond terug in onderstaande en inmiddels afgelopen VI Live.

items.title: Everton overleeft goal oud-Vitessenaar door Barry in topvorm
items.summary: Everton heeft vrijdagavond in de Premier League afgerekend met Coventry City, al ging dat lang niet van harte. De topvorm van Thierno Barry bracht echter redding voor de Toffees , die op achterstand kwamen door een oude bekende voor de Eredivisie-fanatiekelingen.

items.title: Charlton’s struggles expose ‘absolute ocean’ between WSL and second tier
items.summary: Pointless after eight games, Karen Hills’ team are struggling to compete against clubs with chunkier wallets Played eight, lost eight. Welcome to the Women’s Super League, Charlton Athletic, a club in danger of being chewed up, toyed with and spat straight back out by the top tier. Bruised by their 6-0 defeat against Chelsea on Sunday, last season’s playoff winners are finding WSL life tough, conceding more than three goals per game on average and struggling to compete against clubs with chunkier wallets. But are they underperforming or are they merely the victims of their own success? Continue reading...

items.title: Bellinghams celebrate ‘beautiful story’ as Jobe joins Jude in Tuchel’s England 2.0
items.summary: Jude had asked head coach to scout Dortmund midfielder ‘It will be beautiful for Jude to have his brother close’ Thomas Tuchel has given a first England call-up to Jobe Bellingham, admitting the midfielder’s older brother, Jude, had nagged him to do so, as he set up the prospect of their family dream being realised. Tuchel’s inclusion of the younger Bellingham for the Nations League games against Croatia and Spain was further evidence of his shift away from the squad that served him well at the World Cup last summer and towards a fresh dynamic for the mission to win Euro 2028. The manager has named a 25-man group for the game against Croatia at Wembley on Thursday and the one against Spain in Madrid three days after; of the 22 outfield players, only 11 were at the World Cup. Continue reading...

items.title: Matthias Jaissle caught in the storm as Newcastle struggle without European fix
items.summary: Panic building among fans as club visit Craven Cottage but head coach has resolute support of hierarchy At least Matthias Jaissle has a sense of humour. “There’s a lot of storm at the moment,” reflected Newcastle’s head coach on Thursday. A wry smile suggested he was not referring to the north-east weather. Jaissle has seen his tactics, team selection, man management and entire philosophy rubbished in recent days but, on current evidence, appears to be holding his nerve. After all, it is not Jaissle’s fault that his appointment has coincided with supporters, players and directors struggling to adjust to life without Champions League involvement. A disappointing 12th-place finish under Eddie Howe last season dictates that there are no more exciting trips to Barcelona, Paris and Marseille and, significantly, no much-needed boost to club finances. Indeed, Newcastle are finding life without last term’s continental fix so tricky that they travel to Fulham on Saturday with the disgruntled mindset of a passenger accustomed to flying business class who suddenly finds themselves stuck in a cramped, mid-row economy seat. Continue reading...

items.title: Plus spectaculaire que la Premier League et la Liga : la Pro League n'avait plus connu ça depuis 23 ans
items.summary: Le championnat belge offre plus de spectacle cette saison. Après dix journées, 291 buts ont été inscrits en Pro League, soit une moyenne de 3,23 par match. C'est une augmentation de 26,8 % par rapport à la saison dernière, selon les calculs de La Dernière Heure.

items.title: Ayensa redt het vel van zijn coach met hattrick: Standard rekent af met SK Beveren
